plugins.name: reforge
plugins.description: Four skills that redo your work as a tournament: rewrite rebuilds it from scratch, refactor sharpens it in place, reskin redesigns the interface, audit puts it on trial with a panel of lenses. Every attempt is scored against a frozen rubric, fought head-to-head against the reigning champion, and reported with a round-by-round table.
